name: Echo CS-2511P
blurb: Rear-handle 25.0 cc saw. Echo's chart: 12″ and 14″ bars, 3/8″ low profile, .050″ gauge, 45 and 52 drive links (91PXL).
intro: The CS-2511P is the rear-handle partner to the CS-2511T. Echo's specification table lists 12″ and 14″ bars and 25.0 cc. The Bars and Chains chart gives only the .050″ rows for the CS-2511P: 91PXL45CQ (45 drive links) on bar 12A0CD3745C, and 91PXL52CQ (52 drive links) on bar 14A0CD3752C, both 3/8″ low profile, filed with a 5/32″ file. The CS-2511T chart also has .043″ 90PX rows; the CS-2511P entry does not.

bars.note: Echo bar 12A0CD3745C; chain 91PXL45CQ. Non-replaceable-nose bar. 5/32″ file, per Echo's chart.
Echo bar 14A0CD3752C; chain 91PXL52CQ. Non-replaceable-nose bar. 5/32″ file, per Echo's chart.
